sentences.text: Researchers tested whether the compound DHPG could stop oxidative cell death in neurons and other cells grown in a lab dish by exposing them to specific chemicals known to trigger ferroptosis.
Experiments showed that DHPG attaches directly to the protein PDI inside living neurons, chemically alters specific parts of it, and stops the enzyme from performing its normal chemical function.
When researchers reduced the amount of PDI using genetic tools, the protective effect of DHPG disappeared, leading the authors to conclude that PDI is required for this protection.
